Fictional pregnancy exposure without reaction
Fictional journal — synthetic case for software testing. DOI: 10.0000/fake.case
Abstract
A fictional 29-year-old took Zentaril in first trimester. No malformation reported at birth in
this made-up vignette. Still an identifiable pregnancy case of interest for screening.
